title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 21, 2026 — President Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks in a speech.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 21, 2026 — President Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks in a speech."

""

"-------"

"SOT1, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (00:05 - 00:18): "Officially, without being afraid, he [Trump] says, 'I want Iran's oil and gas, but they won't let me; I want to come and take it', just as he took Venezuela's, and now everything there is secure and there are no problems anymore!!""

"SOT2, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (00:23 - 01:06): "The current situation is not simple; it is not good for us, the region, or the world. It would be better for us to move, and for them to move, within a framework that recognizes our nation's rights and puts an end to bullying and aggression. Only then can we sit down together and talk comfortably. You cannot close all paths, issue threats, and apply every possible pressure, and then say, 'Let's talk.' What is there to talk about under pressure? You do not implement what you signed; will you implement it now if we negotiate? This is where they must accept acting on what has been said.""

"SOT3, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (01:11 - 01:42): "We are not seeking war; we do not want to fight, but we will under no circumstances submit to force or bullying. This is truly embedded in our culture and beliefs. We were engaged in dialogue, and we are still engaged in dialogue, but unfortunately, they did this to us in the midst of those negotiations.""

"SOT4, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (01:47 - 02:31): "We are holding daily discussions with various countries regarding BRICS, the Shanghai Cooperation Organization, Eurasia, and other existing matters, as we try to increase our interactions with countries in this regard. Of course, it must also be said that these countries themselves are under pressure. Because of the United States' actions, they even want to pressure these countries to block land routes so they do not trade with us; in other words, the issue is not that simple. It is not that simple for them to stand up to the United States; ultimately, they [the US] use force, and in the face of that force, these countries back down. Nevertheless, despite all of this, they continue to cooperate.
